_meta.name: Libras
_meta.notes: Each value is the sign(s) for that text, written as entries of dictionary.json separated by spaces (Encerrar_Turno is one entry with two signs). A text listed here is shown with its signs next to the words; a text left out stays written only - that is every button and menu for now. To sign one, add its key here, e.g. "menu": { "play": "Jogar" }, and put the sign in dictionary.json. Card names and descriptions are not listed: they are glossed word by word from the pt-BR text, as the sign progression changes them.
